_comment: One or two short coaching cues per Studio LFT exercise, keyed by normalized name (lowercase; '.' and '-' become spaces). Rendered under each exercise on the day card. Entries whose exercise also appears in exercise-library.json reuse that entry's cues so the two apps stay consistent.

1/2 kneeling hip flexor: Squeeze the back glute — that's what opens the hip
Ribs down, don't arch the low back
1db front foot elevated split squat: Front shin stays over the toes
Drive through the front heel to stand
1db lateral lunge: Sit back into the hip, not down into the knee
Toes point straight ahead, chest tall
1kb kickstand crossbody rdl: Most of the weight stays on the planted leg
Rotate through the ribs, not the low back
2db lateral lunge: Push the hips back as you step out
Straight leg stays straight — feel that stretch
4pt rocking: Push and pull with the arms to find range
Keep the knees just off the floor
active straight leg raise with ball sque: Squeeze the ball as hard as you can the whole set
Low back stays flat as the leg lowers
adductor rockback: Straight leg stays long, toes forward
Rock only as far as you can control
back squat: Big breath and brace before you unrack
Knees track out over the toes
back/front squat: Pick the bar position you can stay tall in
Full breath at the top of every rep
ball chest slam + core engaged leg raise: Low back stays glued to the floor
Slow the legs down, don't drop them
ball reverse lunge with chop: Bear hug the ball, chest stays tall
Back knee down before the chop
ball slam: Squat to pick up — back flat, chest tall
Load the hips and slam with intent — full body explosion
ball slam broad jump: Slam hard, then straight into the jump
Stick the landing before you reset
band assisted reverse nordic: Squeeze the glutes to keep hips open
Only lean as far as you can come back from
band chop: Arms stay straight — turn through the core
band curl: Control it back down, no swinging
band face pull: Pull to eyebrow height, elbows high
Squeeze the shoulder blades at the end
band over and back: Keep tension wide the whole way
Go only as wide as the shoulders allow
band pec fly: Meet the hands out in front of the chest
Slight bend in the elbows, hold it
band plank row: Row to the ribs, not the shoulder
band pull apart: Let it touch the bottom of the sternum
band pull through: Arms stay long — the hips do the work
Squeeze the glutes to finish tall
band resisted glute bridge: Drive the knees out against the band
Squeeze the glutes at the top, ribs down
band resisted lateral lunge: Push away from the anchor to stand
Chest stays tall as you sit into the hip
band sa power row: Big drive of the elbow behind you
Stay square — don't let the torso spin
band straight arm pulldown: Arms stay straight, pull to the lap
Feel the lats, not the arms
band triceps press down: Elbows locked in place, only the forearms move
Lean in slightly and press the floor away
band x rear delt pull apart: Lead with the pinkies, wide arc
Wider stance if you feel unsteady
banded barbell box squat: Sit to the box, don't relax on it
Explode up — the band gets heavier at the top
banded broad jump: Land and hold — stick every rep
Reset fully before the next jump
banded pin bench press example video doe: Start from a dead stop on the pins
Drive the feet into the floor as you press
banded sumo deadlift: More squat than hinge on this one
banded t spine rotation: Let the band pull you under, then squeeze back
Rotation comes from the upper back
barbell bent over row: Pull the elbows past the ribs
barbell zercher split squat: Slight forward lean to load the glutes
Elbows stay high, bar stays tight to you
bb rdl: Shave the bar down the thighs
bb rnt rdl: Pull the bar into your body the whole way
Let the band remind you to hinge back
bench hand/knee support band db row: Back flat and level like a tabletop
Row to the hip, not the shoulder
bench press: Drive the feet into the floor
bent over plate raise: Raise to shoulder height, no higher
bird dog contra laterals: Drag the toe along the floor to wake the glute
bird dog contralaterals: Drag the toe out, then lift at the end
bird dog legs only: Small lift at the end of each extension
Squeeze the glute, don't arch the back
body row: Pull the chest to the bar
Squeeze the glutes to stay in one line
bodyweight split squat: Torso stays upright the entire set
bodyweight squat w/ pause: Pause at the deepest position you own
Chest tall through the whole rep
box dip: Manage the depth — shoulders shouldn't complain
Chest stays proud, elbows track back
box pistol squat +body row: Control the way down to the box
bridge walk outs: Hips stay high the whole time
Small steps out, small steps back
broad jump: Land in a deep squat and own it
Walk back and reset — no rushed reps
bulgarian hip flexor stretch: Squeeze the glute of the back leg
bulgarian split squat bodyweight: Switch when it burns, plus three
bw squat: Slow on the way down, own the bottom
Press the floor away to stand
close grip pull up (band assisted as nee: Drive the elbows down into the ribs
Use only as much band as you need
continuous squat jump: Set up each rep — no bouncing
Land soft in a deep squat
contralateral dead bug: Low back stays pressed to the floor
contralateral deadbug: Only go as low as you can control
conventional deadlift: Neutral spine — set the back before you pull
Drive the floor away, bar stays close
conventional/sumo deadlift: Pick the stance you can hold position in
Bar stays against the legs the whole pull
copenhagen hip drop: Drive the top leg down into the bench
Hips stay stacked — drop and lift, don't roll
copenhagen march: Drive the top leg down into the box
Hips stay stacked, don't roll back
core engaged leg raise: Upper back stays off the ground
Lower the leg only as far as the back stays flat
crunch with feet on box: Low back stays down — this isn't a sit-up
Exhale at the top of every crunch
db 45 degree forward lunge alt: Step out on the diagonal with control
Press through the front foot to return
db back support single arm shoulder pres: Drive the feet into the floor
Ribs down — don't arch to press
db bench press: Elbows about 45 degrees, not flared wide
Control the DBs down every rep
db chest supported row: Pull the DBs to the lower ribs
db deadstop row with hand support: Full reset on the floor each rep
Big pull to the hip, back stays flat
db fly press: Field goal arms at the bottom
Big stretch on the chest, then press
db goblet spanish squat: Let the band pull the knees forward
db incline bench press: Pause two seconds at the bottom
Slow tempo — that's the whole point
db incline fly: Soft bend in the elbows, hold it there
Hug a big tree at the top
db incline pec fly: Control the weight down, slightly bent elbow
Squeeze the chest at the top
db pause goblet squat: Hold three seconds at the bottom
db pullover: Ribs down — don't let the back arch
db rack support single leg rdl: Push the butt back for the stretch
Squeeze the glute to stand tall
db rdl: Hips back, not down — this is a hinge, not a squat
Slide the DBs down the thighs — keep them close
db reverse lunge: Torso stays tall — don't lean forward
Back knee down, drive through the front heel
db rotational row in lunge: Lower body stays still — rotate the upper back
Pull the DB from the floor each rep
db sa bench press: Punch the DB to the ceiling
Brace hard — don't let the hips twist
db single arm bicep curl: Body stays still, only the arm moves
db single arm incline press: Core braced so the torso stays square
db skull crusher: Elbows stay pointed at the ceiling
Lower to the forehead, not the chest
db sl hip thrust: Drive through the HEEL of the working leg — not the toe
Squeeze the glute hard at the top — full hip extension
db split squat: Drop straight down — like an elevator, not an escalator
Front knee tracks over the toes
db/bb push press: Small dip, big drive from the legs
Punch the head through at lockout
dead bug leg raise with upper body ball: Squeeze the ball hard with straight arms
Low back stays flat as the leg lowers
dead bug press: Press straight up over the shoulder
Opposite leg lowers slow and controlled
deficit calf raise: Full stretch at the bottom, full squeeze at the top
deficit db/kb reverse lunge: Step back off the plate with control
Torso tall, back knee toward the floor
double trouble: kb clean, kb squat, kb r: Pick a pace you can hold for the whole complex
drop squat to pause: Drop fast, then freeze in the bottom
Land soft and hold the position
dynamic pigeon: Back leg stays long and active
Rotate the hips around the back leg
elevated goblet squat band tall kneeling: Pull the elbows down to the ribs
explosive band horizontal press: Punch out fast on every rep
Keep tension on the band, stay square
explosive band press: Punch out fast on every rep
Stay square, don't twist into it
explosive horizontal band press: Keep tension on the band the whole set
face pull: Pull to face height, elbows high
feet elevated glute bridge: Squeeze the glutes at the top
Ribs down, don't arch to get higher
fire hydrant: Lift with the glute, not the low back
Hips stay square to the floor
floating heel landmine goblet squat: Weight stays in the balls of the feet
front foot elevated 2db low load split s: Knee travels toward the floor, not forward
Stand up with control, no bounce
front foot elevated barbell split squat: Front foot on the plate, back knee to the floor
front squat: Elbows high in the front rack
glute bridge pull apart: Glutes stay tight the whole set
Let the fists touch the floor
hamstring body curls: Hold the body row position hard
Pull through the heels on the box
hanging knee raise: Control the legs down, no swinging
Knees to hip height or higher
hanging scap shrug: Pull the shoulder blades down, arms stay straight
Stand on the box if the hang is too much
hardstyle high plank: Screw the hands into the ground
Squeeze everything — this is max tension
heels elevated goblet squat: Only set the DB down during the rest
high angle single arm band row: Loop the band on the wrist to save the elbow
Half-kneeling, ribs down, pull to the ribs
high plank w/ alternating hip flexion: Hips stay level as the knee comes in
hinged over sa lat stretch: Shift the hips away from the hand
hinged over single arm lat stretch: Let the ribs open as you breathe
inchworm push up: Walk out slow — control every step
Full push up at the bottom of the walk
ipsilateral dead bug: Same arm and leg lower together
kb 3pt row: Pull to the hip, control it down
kb anterior loaded good morning: Hinge back, chest points to the floor
kb clean to overhead press 2 hand: Pop it with the legs, catch it soft
Hold the horns, press from the goblet
kb halo: Tight circle — keep the bell close to the head
Duck slightly as it passes behind
kb lateral shift swing 2hand: Shift as the bell goes under the hips
Stand tall as it comes back to center
kb plank pull through: Hips stay square — resist the twist
Reach through and drag it clean across
kb sa swing: Power from the hips, arm stays relaxed
kb swing: Hips are the engine — NOT your arms
Hike the KB high between your legs — get it past your hips
kb t rex swing: Hips snap, elbows bend — bell floats to the chest
It's still a hinge — don't squat the swing
kb/db curtis p complex front rack squat: Pick a pace you can repeat
Reset the front rack between pieces
Pick a pace you can repeat
Reset the front rack between pieces
kb/db death march in place: Hinge back, switch feet each rep
kb/db squat lunge press combo: Move steady — 10 seconds rest only if you need it
kettlebell upright row: Zip it up the front of the body
Elbows lead, stop at shoulder height
kickstand 2db rdl: Most of the weight on the front leg
Shave the DBs down the front of the leg
landmine heels: Heels on the plate, knees drive forward
Chest stays tall in the goblet position
lateral lunge step together lunge: Sit back into the hip each side
Stand up into the stepping leg
lateral lunge to curtsy lunge: Switch sides when it burns, plus three
lateral step together lunge: Push the hips back as you step out
loaded push up: Hands outside the shoulders, fingers forward
Body moves as one straight line
lu raise: Let the hands rotate as the plates go up
Go light — this is harder than it looks
mb complex clean squat pushup slam: Pick a pace you can hold without gassing
Full slam, then straight into the next round
mb russian twist: Rotate through the ribs, not just the arms
Elevate the feet if you want more
med ball russian twist: Chest stays tall as you rotate
med ball slam: Full reach overhead before the slam
Two breaths between reps, reset each one
neutral grip pull up (band assisted as n: Drive the elbows down to the ribs
Only reset the grip during the 10 seconds
overhead band tricep press: Press the fists toward the ceiling
pause push up (band assist if needed): Hold the bottom for two full seconds
pelvic tilts: Small movement — the core does the work
plank kb pull thru: Hips stay square — resist the twist
Reach through and drag it clean across
plate bent over rear delt raise: Go lighter than you think you need
plate crazy ivan: Feet stay planted on the floor
Take the plate all the way overhead
plate press out squat: Press the plate away as you sit down
Pull it back in as you stand
prisoner good morning: Butt goes back, chest stays proud
Squeeze the glutes to stand tall
pull up/chin up: Drive the elbows into the ribs
Use as little assistance as you can
push up: Body in one line — head to heels, no sagging hips, no piked butt
Elbows at 45° — not flared out to the sides
quadruped adductor stretch: Straight leg stays long, toes forward
Rock back only as far as it stays comfortable
quadruped hip circles: Slow circles, bigger with each pass
quadruped hip extensions: Lift with the glute, spine stays neutral
quadruped rocking: Shift back only as far as the back stays flat
rack aslr hs stretch: Press the heel into the upright
Other leg stays flat on the floor
rdl wall drill: Touch the glutes to the upright
rnt barbell rdl: Pull the bar into your body
Let the band teach you to hinge back
sa db bench press: Drive the feet in to stay square
One side at a time — brace hard
seated deficit calf raise: Drop the heel for a full stretch
Pause at the top of every rep
seated leg hs curl: Hook the band behind the heel
shoulder car 1/2 kneeling: Let the hand rotate as you go
side plank clam (from knees): Hips stay lifted the whole time
Open the knee with the glute
side plank hip drop: Pull the elbow into the ribs
Small drop, big squeeze back up
single arm arnold press: Start with the palm facing you
Rotate as you press, brace so the torso stays square
single arm band row with kb rack hold: Drive the elbow back, let the trunk follow
single arm bench deadstop row: Full rest on the ground between reps
Big pull — let the trunk rotate a little
sl hip hinge w/ ball reach: Straight line from heel to head
Hips stay square to the floor
snatch grip elevated deadlift: Wide grip, chest up, back flat
Only set the bar down during the rest
spanish split squat: Switch when it burns, plus three
squat jump: One jump at a time — set each one up
Land in a deep squat with control
squat jump w/ stick: Stick the landing and hold it
Full reset before the next rep
standing band hamstring curl: Pull the heel to the butt
standing pec stretch: Elbow slightly higher than the shoulder
sumo med ball zercher good morning: Toes out, hinge back with a flat back
t spine rotation: Squeeze the shoulder blades at the top
tuck jump: Knees to the chest, land soft
Own every landing before the next
wall support sl standing clam: Open the hip with the glute
Hips stay square to the wall
wall support standing clam: Squeeze the glute on the standing side
Stay hinged — don't stand up out of it
wide grip pull up assisted as needed: Drive the elbows down to the ribs
